work.title: Untitled (CD Grid Array)
work.description: Multiple compact discs are mounted across a layered collage incorporating grid-patterned targets, red horizontal ribbon stripes, and fragments of yellow, green, and orange panels. Plastic sheeting, printed paper ephemera, and a small red heart-shaped element punctuate the densely packed, shelf-like horizontal composition.
work.composition: horizontal layered shelves with scattered CDs
